title: English Conversation 45:  Making an Appointment
content: 1. to make an appointment: to schedule a time to see someone - I will make an appointment to get a haircut tomorrow. - Did you make an appointment to see the doctor? 2. an annual check-up: a health check-up that one receives one time every year - I have an annual check-up tomorrow. - Do you get an annual check-up? 3. an insurance card: a card that has all of one's insurance information on it - Can I see your insurance card? - I lost my insurance card. I need to get a new one.
